title: Complete Set
text: Complete Set. This is a complete set of measuring cups and spoons. They are a mix of stainless steel and plastic. The stainless part feels sturdy. The plastic doesn't. It flexes easily and is not very rigid. It's easy to read the measurements. It seems to be dishwasher friendly.

product_metadata.title: 8 Pieces Measuring Cups and Spoons Set/Nesting Measuring Cups with Stainless Steel Handle/for Dry and Liquid Ingredient (Sky blue)
features: 【8 Pieces - Multi Size】Including 4 measuring cups (1/4 cup, 1/3 cup, 1/2 cup, 1 cup), 4 measuring spoons (1/2 tsp, 1 tsp, 1/2 tsp, 1 tbsp ), 1 funnel. Meet all your needs on cooking and baking.
【Premium Material】The measuring cups set made of food-grade stainless steel and PP plastic, 100% rust-resistant, no BPA. which is safe to use for both dry and wet ingredients.
【Dishwasher Safe】The measuring set has no sharp & rough edges around the rim which guarantee your hands safety during hand wash. It is also dishwasher safe.
【Complete and Marked Set】Each measuring cup and spoon is clearly marked with a volume and mL measurements on the handles for fast recognition and preciseness.

【Minimalist style and Easy to Store】Our measuring spoons and cups are attached by 2 steel rings to keep the sets together and always handy. The surface of the plastic measuring spoons is frosted. And the elegant nordic blue will bring a pop of color to your recipe prep.
